Cost: 500eb (Expensive)
Class: Assault Rifle
Range: Carbine
Pre-installed: Extended Magazine, Short Scope (effects already included in these stats)

Loads only Basic ammo, won't fire with fewer than 3 loaded, and can't take any Burst Mod Internals. Every attack picks a burst mode: Burst (3) fires 3 rounds that also count as Armor-Piercing; Burst (6) fires 6 rounds that also count as Explosive (with its -2 to hit and no Aimed Shots); Burst (9) fires 9 rounds for +1d6 (5d6). Each larger burst also has the effects of the smaller ones, but only uses its own round count.

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
